137001.description:
It's gonna take more than a half-hearted dye job for plain-faced Yanagi to make a successful college debut, and that's something he has to learn the hard way. His senior at work Igarashi, whose effortless looks and intense personality make him popular with everyone, might be the best person to ask for advice. But should he really trust the same guy who randomly bit his finger to hold a piercing gun to his earlobe?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

She holds the root of her worries against her bosom... ♥

Note: Published in Komiflo Original

title.native: バストコンプレックス

137004.description:
Akihito is a diligent local masseur who is loved by his regular elderly customers. He has but a simple dream, to find a person of his type: A black-haired beauty. When his co-workers learn about it, they tease him, telling him to have realistic standards on finding a girlfriend. But the thing is, Akihito's co-workers don't have an idea that Akihito isn't looking for the ideal girl but the ideal man. In short, he's gay. Enter Kei Himemiya, the new trainee. The first time Akihito laid his eyes on Kei, Kei totally has everything Akihito is looking for in an ideal partner that it's almost a miracle. And when the two got closer and slept together, Akihito is over the moon for Kei. Is this the start of a blossoming love life for Akihito, or is Kei not that ideal as he seems?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.native: 理想の恋人 姫宮くん

137005.description:
One normal day, Jung's little brother Hoon goes missing. Jung sees her family fall into despair as the search for her brother drags on without any hope of him coming back. But one day Jung wakes up to 6 months ago, the day her brother went missing, She is the only one who remembers. Will she be able to change the course of time?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

137018.description:
On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school student about to transfer to a new school, saw his blonde classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though Aoi was a complete stranger to him, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone, so he took her home. “Thanks for the hot bath.” “I-It’s fine…” When Akira heard about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decided to help her and let her live with him until he transferred to a new school. While confused by their new cohabitation arrangement, the two slowly grew close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)
synonyms: A Story Of Taking Home A Lonely Gal From My Class And Turning Her Into An Elegant Beauty
把班上的孤單辣妹帶回家改造成清純美女的故事

title.romaji: Class no Bocchi Gyaru wo Omochikaeri Shite Seisokei Bijin ni Shiteyatta Hanashi

137020.description: Every day leads to fresh new things to see and touch. The little girl's casual life is full of new firsts. Today, another first comes!

137021.description: Shiro is an unemployed NEET that suddenly has to take care of his sister's son Kujira.

title.native: 奴隷ちゃんは食べられたい

137023.description:
Her hobbies are shopping, desserts... and killing vampires.

One day, a girl transferred to my school and stunned the class with her shocking self-introduction.
She will turn my my dull gray high school life bright red.

A unique coming-of-age love comedy between a "self-proclaimed vampire-hunting gal" and a "high school boy who lives in the shadows"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 魔祓井さんは僕を狩りたい
タクシーはブラックじゃありません

137025.description:
Tatsuo and Satoru are a student and a teacher who are also in a secret relationship. Satoru is a straight-laced literature teacher who is determined not to touch Tatsuo until after he graduates. Unfortunately, Tatsuo is all too interested in physical pleasure, and tries new ways to seduce the older man every day. One day, Satoru's beloved cat, Natsume, suddenly starts to talk! Tatsuo wants her help to take his relationship to the next level, so he reveres Natsume as his professor, and asks her to teach him how to seduce her owner...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Include the one-shot Now Playing (なうぷれいんぐ)

title.english: The Spoiled Cat and the Square Darling
title.native: だだっ子にゃんこと堅物ダーリン

137026.description:
In the deepest level of the dungeon. We found the final "treasure" —

It was the "Daring Swimsuit"

The adventuring party returned to town and went their separate ways. Mana the wizard was changing out of her clothes when she saw the Daring Swimsuit.

"What would happen if I put it on?"

It is a forbidden door that will open to a world of sensual pleasure. Would you like to open it?

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)
synonyms: Mana the Witch and the Door of H

title.native: 魔法使いマナと叡痴の扉
title.romaji: Mahoutsukai Mana to H no Tobira

137027.description:
Princess, hero, priestess, witch, and maid.
If you had to choose one to be your queen, who would it be?

The war between humans and demons had just ended, but the world still feared more conflict. The only way to assure peace is for the Demon Lord (female) to take a human queen!

Which heroine will you choose? Your choice will help guide the story to its conclusion! It's a new kind of reader-participation harem comedy!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

137028.description:
In a world coming to its end, who do you want to be loved by? As the end of the world ticks by, this is a story of two girl's trembling love, and their terrifying memories. (This is a comedy)

(Source: ComicSmart, translated)
synonyms: I Wouldn't Choose Her Even if the World Ended
I Won't Choose Her When the World's End

title.native: たとえ世界が終わっても、私は彼女を選ばない
title.romaji: Tatoe Sekai ga Owattemo, Watashi wa Kanojo wo Erabanai

137029.description:
Two years after the death of the idol Sora Tajima, who was the center of the idol group Polaris, people are gradually forgetting about her. High school girl Mizuumi Tachibana can't accept this, and attempts the impossible in order to prove the existence of a "God". In a world where likes are everything, she will create the eternal idol.

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

137030.description:
After parting from her husband, Yoshiko leaves their mansion and starts living alone in an apartment. A man falls in love with her, and chases her. She ignores the man, and walks in the city. During the walk they encounter Yakuza...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

137031.description:
Jean Pildu, a serial killer who killed as many as 25 people, was arrested by police as a wanted criminal and sentenced to death in court. However, the day before the execution day, he slipped on a banana peel and suffered a concussion, losing all his memory. Execution of the sentence is suspended since it is not possible to punish a person who has no memory of their misdeeds. Experts from various fields are mobilized to retrieve the memory of Jean Pildu.

(Source: natalie.mu, translated)

137032.description:
When Da-Eun wakes up, she finds herself in a dating simulation game as Diana, a pretty schoolgirl surrounded by beautiful people with floating hearts above their heads. To her surprise, there seem to be no rules beyond the ability to conquer anyone, regardless of their gender, age, or even species -- yes, even dogs have heart-o-meters! Dating is fun, sure, but Diana has something else in mind… the ultimate goal of the dating sim genre -- to form a harem. She starts to strategize, but will things pan out as she plans?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

137033.description:
A sparrow named O-chun crashed into the studio of a struggling young painter. To thank him for healing her injuries, O-chun will cheerfully return the favor any way she can! A relationship between human and bird that transcends biological boundaries in a cute modern fairy tale!

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

Note: Originally published as shorts on the author's Twitter before being picked up for serialization.

137034.description:
"Please stay by my side."
After getting involved in a scandal, Kihae is forced to give up his acting career. Then he starts hearing voices whenever he encounters strangers. Therapy, music, avoiding people — he's tried it all, but nothing seems to help. That is, until he meets Mujin.

(Source: Manta)

137036.description:
Rumor has it that the emperor and the prime minister are at odds with each other, and some people say that the prime minister got his position because he looks like the emperor's former lover. But is that the truth? One is a mean and seemingly aloof emperor, and the other is a weak prime minister who is excluded by others. One is chasing, and the other is escaping, but the social stigma stops them from moving forward. Can they relive the good old days of the past?

(Source: Webcomics)

137038.description: Hayashi has to take remedial lessons during summer vacation, but that gives her the chance to spend time alone with her crush, Nagi-kun. How will she take advantage of this opportunity?

137042.description:
Every family has its own "secrets"... Meet our protagonist, Shota Minamoto, a junior-high school student who also happens to be an orphan in a children's home. One day, he was adopted by a family living in a luxurious, Japanese-style estate. Welcomed warmly by them all, Shota started letting his guard down but this family had a "secret" that the world could never know.

A new work from the creator of "The Cuckoo's Fiance" showcasing a different kind of "family." Thus begins a cozy, bloody love comedy!

(Source: K-Manga)
synonyms: ผีดูดเลือดบ้านฮิอิรางิ

137044.description: A two-part story about a lonely god and a troubled high school girl.

137045.description:
Kurumi's finally in a relationship with the older lover of her dreams - cool, stoic Ms. Yoroizuka, who seems just as emotionless outside the office as she does within her department. You might think shy, younger Kurumi's the one getting spoiled here, but you would be wrong - Kurumi will do anything to spoil Ms. Yoroizuka with all the head pats, hugs, and kisses she deserves! (Source: Manga Planet)

Note:
- Includes 11 extra chapters.
- Originally self-published and then collected into one commercial volume published on 2021-07-21. It was picked up for continued commercial serialization on 2022-08-06.

title.english: I Want to Spoil Ms. Yoroizuka Rotten
title.native: 鎧塚さんをバブらせたい

137046.description: The story follows Kokoro Fuyukawa and Satoru Yukidoh, who frequently experience a phenomenon that makes their minds switch place with each other, putting them in the other person's body. Kokoro is stuck in a blizzard in an emergency cabin on a mountain together with three other people, while Satoru is in an institute for the treatment of mentally ill criminals, having lost his memory.

137047.description: Note: Winner of the No. 106 Newcomer's Manga Prize Special Encouragement Award.

137048.description:
A collection of works by various authors:

01. Meogireul Juseyo! (먹이를 주세요!, Please Feed Me!) [Junggak]
02. Bad Night Kiss (배드 나잇 키스) [Gae-Syak Gom]
03. Seonakgwa (선악과, Forbidden Fruit) [Wiji]
04. Sinsujeon (신수전, Halfling Gods) [Story: Jayjay, Art: Gang Jun]
05. Kkoriwa Kkori Sai (꼬리와 꼬리 사이, Between Two Tails) [Nu-Ne]

137049.description:
Ye Yu Xiao, a young master, who is a player, self proclaimed that he's a rich young master who will not get himself into trouble. He accidentally met Fan Jing, a new star who is well known for playing "hard to get". In order to make the the proud and stubborn beauty fall completely in love with him, Ye Yu Xiao made a bet with his friends that Fan Jing would fall in love with him within 3 months. However, 3 months later...the scenario of chasing the wife changed! Who will be the first to fall into the trap of this love match?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

137050.description:
A famous beauty influencer's secret.

B-Magic is the hottest beauty vlogger in the beauty industry. Everyone is always waiting for her next upload! Little do they know that B-Magic is trying to live a normal life as a high school boy? What secrets is she hiding? And will her classmates uncover her identity?

(Source: Manta)

137052.description:
Lee Soo-ha ran into the boy Jang Seon-ho, who made fun of her weight all those years ago. Why is he being so nice after all these years?

(Source: Toomics)

137053.description:
"You're a bright light, you're the God of Beauty who has come to the human world"

When a reserved and stoic movie fan meets the innocent and awkward Best Actor, Su Yan found what he wanted amidst the bright light, and Xia Tingwan solved the problem of love in Su Yan's profound gaze.

"Tingting, I know. Ever since the first time I watched Whalespeak, I knew that you weren't acting as Xia. I knew that you are Xia himself."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

137057.description:
To fill the loneliness of being neglected by her unfaithful boyfriend, Sou-kun, Haru begins working in the sex industry. As she gets paid a not insignificant amount of money, and as she puts her body on top of many customers as if to confirm her own worth, her feelings gradually change...? The struggles of a prostitute who lives hard at night!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

137058.description:
Discover real episodes, from stories of troubled customers to funny happenings, giving a full understanding of the difficulties and interesting things that lie behind the scenes in the sex industry.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 待機室のあわひめっ～風俗嬢3人娘のホンネきいて～
title.romaji: Taikishitsu no Awa Hime: Fuzokujou 3 Nin Musume no Honne Kiite

137059.description:
The story is about the tragedy and joy of women who work hard in nightclubs, covered in bubbles, from a professional's point of view with a lot of charm. A must-see for both men and women!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: あわひめ～風俗待機室の内緒話～
title.romaji: Awa Hime: Fuuzoku Taikishitsu no Naishobanashi

137060.description:
One morning, Marune, an office worker who loves the Warring States period, wakes up to find a strange man next to her... a younger man who looks like Nobunaga Oda, whom she met last night. Marune makes grilled miso to calm her mind, but she is unexpectedly reunited with Nobunaga Oda. But he has a very beautiful girlfriend... Will the recipes of the Warring States period save love?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 戦国ごはんの丸根さん

137062.description:
Often cited as the origin of the heta-uma (or 'bad but good' ) style of manga art, Penguin Gohan is a classic Garo gag manga featuring the crude, lewd, and gory exploits of a penguin and his family. It is a wild anthology of 20 surreal stories characterized by a grotesque humor bordering on ero-guro and nonsense.

In Penguin Gohan, the literary genius of the eclectic Shigesato Itoi combines with the singular art of Teruhiko Yumura, one of the greatest masters of Japanese underground illustration.

The series has been published three times since its original run in Garo, and each edition has been slightly different: first by JOHO Center Publishing in 1980 (Jounetsu no Penguin Gohan), by Chikuma Bunko in 1993 (Kanpon Jounetsu no Penguin Gohan), and by Hobonichi Books in 2011 (Sayonara Penguin).

title.native: 情熱のペンギンごはん

137064.description:
Nan Yue was only in transit in the Kingdom of Elven. But she found that she signed a marriage contract with Ah Sha, the elven princess. Wait, I am a girl! How could I marry the princess? Wait, why am I wanted by the world after I sign the marriage contract?? To survive, I have to take the princess for a leap of faith:

"As expected of an uptown girl, you are pretty hot!
"Get lost, you perv!"!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

137069.description:
"You will choose amongst yourselves with a majority vote. You are the ones to decide. Who is unnecessary, the most hateful, who is ok to die."

Out of concern for his best friend Sara's stalker issue, Joe decided to escort her home. However, as soon as they reached her house, they were attacked by someone and lost consciousness. When next Sara and Joe wake up, they find themselves in a strange facility. There, they find strange similarly kidnapped people. Including Joe and Sara, the 11 people-- despite being driven by suspicion-- cooperate, encourage each other, and become friends. While Joe protects Sara, he believes in everyone else and resolves to escape the facility. And yet, what awaited him was a Death Game where "Someone's death will be decided by everyone else."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Your Turn To Die: Death Game by Majority Side Joe

title.native: キミガシネ　―多数決デスゲーム― side ジョー
title.romaji: Kimi ga Shine: Tasuketsu Death Game - Side Joe

137070.description:
Kim Sojin lived an intense everyday life as an oriental doctor. However, after losing her life in a fire accident, she woke up again in the Goguryeo period as the daughter of the Jeolnobu Yeon Clan 'Yeon Woohee.'

Although she was born into a noble family, war breaks out every day in this era! And now that she's twelve, she's going through a political marriage?!

synonyms: 不良娘（ヤンキーっこ）ならし
เปลี่ยนยัยตัวร้ายให้เป็นยัยน่ารัก

137072.description:
What fell from the ceiling, was a tiny girl that looked like a 10 year old.

(Source: DAYcomics)

137073.description:
After the loss of a loved one, Ji-Su is offered a helping hand from her late grandmother’s student, who provides her with a place to stay and takes her under her wing. Despite her wish to get along, Ji-Su gets off on the wrong foot with their only son, Ha-Jin, who mistakes her for a stalker after he encounters her on his doorstep. Will Ji-Su be able to resolve this misunderstanding and befriend Ha-Jin? Or will their relationship turn into something more?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
synonyms: แด่รักแรกของฉัน

137074.description:
"I never knew doing it with a guy could feel so good..." When two of his close friends come out as a couple, Yoshi starts wondering what it's like to make love to another guy. When he starts searching online for a partner to experiment with, his friend Kan gets worried, and offers himself up instead! Also included in this volume is "Be Mine," a mature romance about Ryu and Haru, the best friends of Yoshi and Kan.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.native: イきすぎフレンドシップ

137077.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2021 June issue.

137078.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2021 June issue.

137080.description:
What are two underappreciated scientists to do when their greatest invention, the ultimate self-learning android, Alma, insists they’re her parents? Become an extraordinary nuclear family, of course! Alma may be small and cute, but she’s got wicked combat capabilities and an insatiable curiosity about romance and family. Unfortunately, the unexpected co-parents have zero experience with those subjects and constantly find themselves at the mercy of Alma with her barrage of questions and razor-sharp analyses!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

137081.description: Kyoko has such a strong psychic ability that when she sends a spirit into her body, even her appearance changes to match that of the spirit. One day, she sees her own reflection in a mirror, in which appears the image of her boyfriend, Hashimoto, who has left her. She hides the mirror from her family so that they will not find it, and looks at it from time to time.

137082.description:
A young boy named Lin Yan awakened a useless Divine Soul, becoming a laughing stock of everyone he knew. However, no one could've known that his Divine Soul was in fact called the Life-death Coffin, which had the power to overturn the entire world. What's more, a beautiful and powerful women appeared from the coffin and became the boy's teacher. From then onwards, the boy made great progress at an amazing speed, and moved towards his fate of becoming a powerful emperor.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: จักรพรรดิยุทธ์วิญญาณเทพ

137083.description:
"Dammit! You're the one who turned me on, so this is your fault." My demon of a boss has suddenly changed and is lusting insatiably for me. "No! Stop! I just came...! Anh!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: My Boss Has a Craving for Me

137085.description:
With vacuum sucking tentacles, mating press orcs and walls that devour steel, the dangers of being lost in a Milking Trap Dungeon are perilous. Currently lost in its labyrinth, a Master Hero and his new companion Susu explore the winding corridors, finding themselves locked in a series of rooms where sexual perversion is the key to escaping. The Hero might be a master explorer, but they'll need Susu's S-Tier slut stats and sultry body to finish this quest!

(Source: Fakku!)

“All my classmates must die!”

The man had been bullied all his life, for just one reason: His face looked like a pig. While the despair grew day by day, he found himself transported to another world where he made a happy life. But that life was torn apart by his classmates, who were also transported to that world... Done with taking the abuse, the man begins his revenge.

(Source: Comikey)

137095.description:
The story of Ogi, a boy who can see the colours of people and sounds, and the girl who tackles him to the ground one day.

Note: This is a Korean version of the original manga Newton no Tsubomi, created by the same author. The story and art are changed in this version.

137096.description:
The young master Tan Shao has never been in love in his twenty years, until he fell in love at first sight. To pursue to his love interest, Tan Shao tried to get to know the cold Pei Anwu, not realizing that Pei is the "girl" that he fell in love with. As they spend more time together, their relationship began to change…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 14 extras.

137100.description: Tomoru Arihira works at a plant-based goods company. While he does his best every day by devoting himself to his work and the sweets he's fond of, in reality, he's in the middle of a divorce with his wife, a popular actress...?! 137128.description:
Everyone has memories of their first love. For Dong-Ha, however, his first love only ended in regret. In high school, Dong-Ha’s feelings were reciprocated by his crush Sung-Wu, but Dong-Ha avoided his first love for fear for losing his friends if they found out about his sexuality. It wasn’t until later that he tried to express his true feelings, but by then Sung-Wu had disappeared from his life. As Dong-Ha remains remorseful of hurting his first love, One day he receives a package from Sung-Wu. Inside is a novel titled, “Memories of Sorrow from Gyeongseong.” After reading the book, Dong-Ha finds himself sucked into its fictional world. And there he meets novel’s version of Sung-Wu. This time, Dong-Ha vows to never lose his first love again… Two lovers reunited during the Japanese occupied Korea, will they be able to find each other this time?

(Source: Lezhin)

137137.description:
Yume Sonozaki is a shy, reserved college girl who's inexperienced with love.
At her after-school club, she hits it off with a nice older student, Aoi, who becomes her first boyfriend. She's happy with him, but for some reason, they haven't gotten to first base! As the days go by, she finds herself sadder and more desperate.
Yume finally bites the bullet and asks if she can stay the night, and a bewildered Aoi agrees.
Nervously, she waits for Aoi to step out of the shower, only to discover his personality has changed completely. What is this strange, animalistic allure?
Thus begins a love triangle with two men in the same body!

(Source: Renta!)

137139.description:
Da-Na is a freelance illustrator who feels lonely and stressed out from working all day and doing little else. But this all changes when she is joined by a new four-legged friend: a small pomeranian puppy called Myeong-Dong. This cute little pup shows her what unconditional love looks like, and Da-Na does her best to look after her new pal, too.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
synonyms: I gave birth to a dog

137140.description:
Moegi Mizutani is a hard-working office worker who has decided to start her new life in Tokyo.
One day, when she comes back home, a guy in the buff hugs her from behind! She has no idea who it is until she turns around and sees a man with black hair, cat eyes, and a big grin on his face.
He's Haruka, the boy she played with back in her hometown!
He's been teasing and using her as his toy for as long as she can remember, and before she left for Tokyo, they even spent an intimate moment together. That moment made Moegi insecure and completely at a loss to define their relationship.
Things were supposed to be better, but he's back now?and she has no idea why!

(Source: Renta!)

137141.description:
"Do you really mean it? Are you saying you're not feeling good when you're so wet?" He's playing with all my sensitive parts, making my whole body melt. Is this what "coming" feels like...!?

I, Komari Kanata, a perfectionist, have a natural enemy. He's my colleague who always ranks number one in sales, Kiyose Higashimachi. I don't know if he's aware of my opinion about him, but he always picks fights with me. One day, he finds out about a secret of mine...!!

"I can't stop myself when I see your troubled face."

When he strokes me inside with his long fingers... I can't! No matter how sweetly you touch me, you're the only one who I won't let embrace me!! A story about the stormy and heart-fluttering relationship between an unreadable man and a bluffing girl.

(Source: Renta!)

"You're so wet... So lewd." My older childhood friend pretends to be cold, and uses his skilled finger to mess me up inside. Deep within, my stomach starts to get hot and throbs, I'm about to cum...! My neighbor, Yuu, is blunt and cold; but he's the one I have unrequited feelings for. He always treats me lightly and barely pays me any mind. One day, stuck together on accident during a power outage, my heart is pounding, and I grab onto Yuu, who suddenly kisses me...!? Because the person I've always liked touches me so sweetly, I feel like I'm about to melt...! "Things like these, I only do this to you." Yuu, this is foul play...!

Isekaito is on a school trip with his classmates, enjoying his daily life as a normal high school student, when he is suddenly caught up in a death game controlled by a man in military uniform. 137149.description:
A long, long time ago, in the era of legends, there was a knight known as Sir Sid the Barbarian who pledged his sword to the Holy King Arthur. Unparalleled in strength, he was the greatest magical knight of his time, but also a disgrace to the name of chivalry. His evil deeds were countless, and eventually he met his end at the hands of his own king...or so the story goes. Now a thousand years have passed, and Sid is summoned from his eternal slumber by Alvin, a descendant of Arthur and a prince who knows the truth about Sir Sid the Lightning Knight. Honoring his ancient pact, Sid rises from the grave to help Alvin save the kingdom from impending peril and become the new instructor to Alvin’s class of fellow aspiring knights. As danger lurks in the shadows, Sid must train this class of underdogs to rely on more than just their magical fairy swords and teach them the old ways of the magic knights.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The fairy knight lives with old rules

This is not history as we know it. The year is 1600. Ten years have passed since Oda Nobunaga unified the whole of Japan. When Nobunaga realizes he is nearing the end of his life, he announces that he will hand over the reins of power to whoever brings him the strongest warrior. The generals, whose dreams of conquering the country had been crushed, put up their own strongest warriors and aim to become the king of the country! Chouka, an elementary school student who loves fishing, heads out for fishing adventures every day after school. Not only does she engage in regular fishing, but she also fishes without a fishing rod?! Fishing with just fishing line and a hook, or using chopsticks and string for fishing. You can even catch fish with a plastic bottle! Introducing casual fishing that can be done with limited time and tools! And of course, she also takes on serious shore fishing!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
